purpose: Browsable survey of the settlement-building assets we actually hold or can source. Part 1 writes catalogue vibe/asset plans AGAINST this file so the province is designed for the breadth we own. Survey only: this agent downloaded nothing (item 6b owns downloads and ran concurrently).
round2Corrections: Mud Mother Grove (SSE 146557) landed in the vault and contains an explicit HistTree.nif plus a full Argonian ritual/woven/pottery prop set - this single mod closes the Hist-tree gap and the Argonian-props gap that round 1 called critical.

The Xanmeer Tileset's 9 exterior pieces are a TERRACE kit (floor slabs + perimeter walls + corners + a 9.3 m monumental stair), not a dead end: stacking terraces of decreasing footprint IS a stepped pyramid. Round 1 misread this as 'no massing'. Gap downgraded from critical to medium.

CC Ayleid Ruin Resources (83999) is in the vault but is exclusively an INTERIOR tileset (every mesh sits under /interior/). It does not supply exterior massing; it is however a strong xanmeer-interior extension.
Marsh-Rest (50111) ships a plugin and ZERO meshes - round 1 ranked it #2 for sourcing, which was wrong.
Xalfek (55595) is re-bundled third-party clutter with a generic Nord shack; nothing Argonian in form despite the name.
Darkwater Den (52630) is PERMISSION-BLOCKED for our use - its README forbids use of Elianora-original meshes in any public work, and we ship publicly on GitHub Pages.
Both boat mods are keeled, planked, oar-rowed Nord hulls. The raft/canoe gap is NOT closed.

The vault has NO DLC - no Dawnguard, Hearthfire or Dragonborn BSAs, and no Sounds.bsa. Module 90 S74.1 lists Solstheim/Dragonborn and Hearthfire content as high-value source families; they are not actually available.

cultureRule.binding: material-culture.md: two Argonian building cultures are canon and regionally assigned. NEVER blend them in one settlement.

cultures.name: Shadowfen mud/wattle
cultures.description: wattle-and-daub over an exposed log skeleton; round or lumpy shells; walls sweat; sun-blessed mud; ground-level, not stilted

cultures.name: Murkmire reed/stilt
cultures.description: woven reed walls on wooden stilts; platforms extending high into the air, linked to one another, ascending from ground to hover over water and marsh; flexible buoyant timber causeways

cultures.name: Xanmeer (dead layer, not a living culture)
cultures.description: stepped stone pyramids linked by stone bridges; mazelike interiors; vakka-stone mechanisms; maintained as warnings, never inhabited in the modern style. Stone is a moral error post-Duskfall, so no modern Argonian building may read as stone.
cultures.regionHint: province-wide as ruin; densest in the deep interior

cultures.name: Imperial / foreign stone-and-timber
cultures.description: cut stone, mortar, sawn timber, tile and slate; foundations that sank in Murkmire soil; forts, docks, plantations, colonial civic buildings; concentrated where geography and history support it (Gideon, Blackwood, ports)
cultures.regionHint: west/north-west fringe, Topal Bay ports, road corridors

cultures.name: Culturally neutral
cultures.description: containers, tools, rope, rubble, fire, fish gear, generic furniture - readable in any culture's hands

cultures.name: Other foreign (Dunmer, Bosmer, Nord, Breton, Akaviri-flavoured)
cultures.description: use only where lore places these peoples: Dunmer border/Thorn, Bosmer/Valenwood fringe, Nord/Breton crews at ports. Never as a generic Argonian substitute.

families.gapFlag: ROUND-2 RE-READ: the 9 exterior pieces are a TERRACE KIT, not a dead end. floor (3.63 x 3.61 m slab) + half-floors + wall (3.63 x 3.64 m) + half-walls + wallcorner (4.10 m) + stairs (9.30 m run, 4.75 m rise) is exactly the vocabulary for building one terrace; stack terraces of decreasing footprint and the result IS a stepped pyramid, with the stair rise matching one terrace height. What is genuinely absent is decorative monumental frontage - carved facades, roof combs, sculpted stairways, stone causeway bridges between pyramids - so ours will read as clean geometric terracing rather than ornate Mesoamerican relief. That is a look to design to, not a blocker.

breadthWeOwn.conditionVariantCoverage: good for plank/shack (20 broken pieces), farmhouse (5 destroyed shells), xanmeer pottery (8 broken twins), rochester ruins, drowned ruins, Ayleid rubble; POOR for mud huts (none) and docks (one damaged piling)
breadthWeOwn.verdict: ROUND 2: we can now build the Argonian province's core look. Stilt/boardwalk/dock/platform settlements and Imperial stone-timber towns were already strong; Mud Mother Grove adds a real Shadowfen mud culture, the Argonian prop language and a Hist tree, and the Xanmeer terrace kit can mass a stepped pyramid after all. The remaining honest holes are: no native watercraft (rafts/canoes), no grave-stakes, thin mud-hut variety, and no ornamental monumental frontage.
breadthWeOwn.roundOverRound: Round 1 named five critical/high gaps. Round 2 vault contents CLOSED two (Hist tree, Argonian props), PARTIALLY closed one (mud kit), DOWNGRADED one on re-reading the geometry (xanmeer exteriors), and confirmed one fully open (rafts/canoes). Two new gaps were found: unrecorded permissions on the mods we now depend on, and no Skyrim DLC in the vault.

nexusResearch.conducted: 2026-09-02, round 2. RESEARCH ONLY - nothing downloaded. All mod IDs confirmed live against the Nexus API unless flagged unverified.
nexusResearch.method: Nexus v2 GraphQL API (api.nexusmods.com/v2/graphql, same apikey: header) exposes a `mods` query filtering on nameStemmed, description, uploader, author and categoryName. It works from this VM where plain page fetches 403, and is far faster than web search. Filters must be a FLAT dict, one domain at a time (a two-element gameDomainName list ANDs, not ORs). `modFileContents` mesh-filename search exists but returns nothing for Skyrim - not indexed. Recorded so future asset hunts do not re-derive this.
headlineFindings: No true Argonian mud-hut modular kit exists on Nexus. ESO/Murkmire ports do not exist (ZeniMax assets not permitted) and Beyond Skyrim: Argonia has released no public assets. The mud culture will be kitbashed, permanently.
No dugout, outrigger, twin-hulled, reed or raft-village asset exists on Nexus either. Exactly ONE genuine canoe mesh was found. This gap is bound by permissions, not availability.
No banyan or mangrove asset pack exists on Nexus - matching the repo's existing Phase 10 finding.
Skyfall's Sleeping Hist Tree Overhaul is the best purpose-built Hist asset in existence and is canonically correct (the vanilla Sleeping Tree IS a Hist sapling).

indexNotSource.why: a full Black Marsh worldspace with Argonian and Kothringi villages, swamps, jungles, ancient Imperial and Xanmeer ruins, jungle flora and Naga tribes - but it is a COMPILATION OF ~80 OTHER PEOPLE'S RESOURCES. Its credits list is a verified bibliography of exactly the assets a Black Marsh builder needs. DO NOT treat it as a source; treat it as an INDEX and go to the originals.

permissionsConcern.severity: NEEDS AN OWNER RULING - not an agent judgement call
permissionsConcern.issue: Several otherwise-ideal sources carry a 'no porting to other games' clause: the Ayleid Ruins Building Kit (Skyrim/Morrowind only), Argonian Funerary Masks, Script Free Ship Sailing and Elden Root. Our project runs in a BROWSER ENGINE rather than in Skyrim, so that clause is arguably tripped. This affects the single biggest monumental-stone kit on Nexus and the only genuine canoe mesh - i.e. two of our remaining gaps.
